gloss: crop rotation; rotating crops on the same field across seasons

definitions.gloss: crop rotation; rotating crops on the same field across seasons

examples.japanese: {輪作|りんさく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: Protect the soil through crop rotation.

examples.japanese: {輪作|りんさく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{連作障害|れんさくしょうがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Crop rotation can prevent continuous cropping damage.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦{周期|しゅうき}→周期：21707_shuuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{輪作|りんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{入|い}れて→取り入れる：04221_toriireru⟧、⟦{稲|いね}→稲：01820_ine⟧、⟦{大豆|だいず}→大豆：10536_daizu⟧、⟦{麦|むぎ}→麦：05427_mugi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}っている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This farm has adopted a three-year crop rotation cycle, growing rice, soybeans, and wheat in turn.

notes:
Composed of {輪|りん} (ring, cycle) + ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (cultivation, crop). The practice of growing different crops in sequence on the same field to maintain soil health and reduce pest problems.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {輪作|りんさく}⟦{体系|たいけい}→体系：04487_taikei⟧: crop rotation system
- ⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧{輪作|りんさく}: three-year crop rotation
- {輪作|りんさく}⟦{周期|しゅうき}→周期：21707_shuuki⟧: rotation cycle
- {輪作|りんさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{入|い}れる→取り入れる：04221_toriireru⟧: to adopt crop rotation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {連作|れんさく}: continuous cropping — growing the same crop repeatedly on the same land, the practice that crop rotation aims to avoid
- {混作|こんさく}: mixed cropping — growing different crops simultaneously on the same field
- {二毛作|にもうさく}: double cropping — growing two different crops in one year on the same field
